name: Enaga Yurie
source:
A beautiful woman on the verge of turning 30 years old.

She is a widow, not a virgin, and has never given birth.

She is the  proprietress of Manshu-an, a long-established ryokan (Japanese-style inn) in Hinawari Onsen. She is the wife of Iwao Enaga, the former owner of Manshu-an, and after Iwao's death, she took over as the owner and has been running the ryokan mostly on her own. There is a shortage of male help.

She has a delicate face and uses polite language. She is graceful and has an innocent demeanor, in contrast she has large protruding breasts and an ample buttocks that emit pheromones that entice men.

Her guard is always up due to her late husband's passing, but inside is a whirlwind of burning lust, and her service-orientated personality makes her a lecherous beast who loses reason once her lust desires overflow.
